items.source: Uses of NullSafeComparator in org.springframework.util.comparator
Useful generic java.util.Comparator implementations, such as an invertible comparator and a compound comparator.
items.translation: 有用的通用 `java.util.Comparator` 实现，例如可逆比较器和组合比较器。

items.source:
A shared default instance of this comparator, treating nulls higher
than non-null objects.
items.translation: 此比较器的共享默认实例，将 null 视为高于非空对象。

items.source:
A shared default instance of this comparator, treating nulls lower
than non-null objects.
items.translation: 此比较器的共享默认实例，将 null 视为低于非空对象。
